EFCore Day 02 – Lab 
 
Using EF Create Following Models 
Student, Department, Course, Instructor, Car 
 
Model Relationships: 
• Student is assigned to one Department. 
• Department can have Many Students. 
• Student have Many Courses. 
• Course is assigned To Many Students. 
• Instructor is assigned To Many Departments. 
• Department have Many Instructors. 
• Instructor may have one car. 
• Car must be owned by Instructor. 
 
[Using DataAnnotations] 
Student Model Constraints: 
• Student Name MinLength is 3. 
• Student Name MaxLength is 20. 
• Make Name => StdName 
 
Department Model Constraints: 
• Department Name MinLength is 2. 
• Department Name MaxLength is 25. 
• Make Name => DeptName using DataAnnotations 
Instructor Model Constraints: 
• Instructor Name MinLength is 3. 
• Instructor Name MaxLength is 20. 
• Make Name => Ins_Name using DataAnnotations 
• Make Id => Ins_Id using DataAnnotations 
 
Make All Crud Operations in Student
